name: Marcos Ros Sempere - § 16/2
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: and, where appropriate, propose a clear common EU approach to age-appropriate access to online platforms, particularly social media platforms, following an approach based on the protection of children
part_context: Calls on the Commission to assess and, where appropriate, propose a clear common EU approach to age-appropriate access to online platforms, particularly social media platforms, following an approach based on the protection of children’s well-being, a recognition of minors’ cognitive and emotional development needs, and the need to ensure a safe and age-appropriate digital environment, while fully respecting fundamental rights and differences in national approaches;
